dialogues.jp:
なんとなく、今日は静かなところで飯を食いた
い気分になった。
dialogues.en:
Somehow or other, I felt like going to a quiet place to each
lunch.
dialogues.text:
Somehow or other, I felt like going to a quiet place to each
lunch.

dialogues.jp: パンの袋を手に体育館裏へ向かう。
dialogues.en: With bread packet in hand, I headed for the back of the gym.
dialogues.text: With bread packet in hand, I headed for the back of the gym.

dialogues.jp:
あそこなら滅多に人も来ないし、思索を邪魔さ
れることもないだろう。
dialogues.en:
Not many people pass by there, and I likely won't bump into
random people mediating either.
dialogues.text:
Not many people pass by there, and I likely won't bump into
random people mediating either.

dialogues.jp: 俺だって静けさを求めることはあるさ。
dialogues.en: I wanted a quiet place, after all.
dialogues.text: I wanted a quiet place, after all.

dialogues.jp: …………ごくたまに、だけどな。
dialogues.en:
......It's pretty good once in a while to spend a lunch
break thinking to yourself.
dialogues.text:
......It's pretty good once in a while to spend a lunch
break thinking to yourself.

dialogues.jp: ――と、思ったのに。
dialogues.en: --But, just when I thought that.
dialogues.text: --But, just when I thought that.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おや？　奇遇だな、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Ooh? An unexpected meeting, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Ooh? An unexpected meeting, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「やぁ」
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.jp:
普段、人のいない体育館裏には、すでに先客が
いた。
dialogues.en: There were people ahead of me, at the normally deserted gym.
dialogues.text: There were people ahead of me, at the normally deserted gym.

dialogues.jp: しかも二人。しかも、この顔ぶれ。
dialogues.en:
Moreover, it's two people. Even further, they look somewhat
familiar.
dialogues.text:
Moreover, it's two people. Even further, they look somewhat
familiar.

dialogues.jp: 思わずくらりと｛めまい／眩暈｝を感じて、俺は黙り込んだ。
dialogues.en: Stunned speechless, my head started getting dizzy.
dialogues.text: Stunned speechless, my head started getting dizzy.

dialogues.jp:
ああ、もっとも静けさから遠い位置にいる、こ
いつらと鉢合わせてしまうとは……。
dialogues.en: Argh, take me to a place which would be quieter, please...
dialogues.text: Argh, take me to a place which would be quieter, please...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前もうららかな風に吹かれてランチタイム
　を楽しみに来たのか」
dialogues.en: "The winds of fate must have blown you here."
dialogues.text: "The winds of fate must have blown you here."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……まぁ……そういうことになるかな」
dialogues.en: "...Well... you could say that."
dialogues.text: "...Well... you could say that."

dialogues.jp: 俺は仕方なく頷いた。
dialogues.en: Accepting my fate, I nodded my head.
dialogues.text: Accepting my fate, I nodded my head.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「おお、そうかそうか。まあ、狭いところだが
　座れよ」
dialogues.en: "Ooh, indeed, indeed! It's a bit small, but have a seat!"
dialogues.text: "Ooh, indeed, indeed! It's a bit small, but have a seat!"

dialogues.jp:
腰を下ろしたわきの地面をぽんぽんと叩きつつ
俺を手招きする杉並。
dialogues.en:
He patted the ground next to him with his hand, inviting me
to sit down.
dialogues.text:
He patted the ground next to him with his hand, inviting me
to sit down.

dialogues.jp: （……ここはお前の家かっての）
dialogues.en: "(...This sounds like your home.)"
dialogues.text: "(...This sounds like your home.)"

dialogues.jp:
心の中でツッコミを入れつつ、引き返すのもかっ
たるいので、大人しくそこに座る。
dialogues.en:
My heart was being a tsukkomi, but like a good little boy, I
sat down as commanded.
dialogues.text:
My heart was being a tsukkomi, but like a good little boy, I
sat down as commanded.

dialogues.jp:
工藤は家から持参したのか弁当箱をつついてい
た。｛がんもどき／飛龍頭｝とわらびの煮物がすみっこに見える。
dialogues.en:
Kudou had brought a lunchbox from his home. I stared at his
ganmodoki.
dialogues.text:
Kudou had brought a lunchbox from his home. I stared at his
ganmodoki.

dialogues.jp: 「えらく渋いモン食ってるな」
dialogues.en: "That looks really good."
dialogues.text: "That looks really good."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……覗くなよ」
dialogues.en: "...Don't be a busybody."
dialogues.text: "...Don't be a busybody."

dialogues.jp:
工藤は何故だかちょっと恥ずかしそうに弁当を
隠した。
dialogues.en: Kudou got oddly embarassed, trying to conceal his lunchbox.
dialogues.text: Kudou got oddly embarassed, trying to conceal his lunchbox.

dialogues.jp:
別にいいじゃないか、と首をひねりながら俺も
パンの袋を開けた。
dialogues.en:
I shook my head in light disbelief asn I opened my bread
packet.
dialogues.text:
I shook my head in light disbelief asn I opened my bread
packet.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「しかし、なんだな」
dialogues.en: "Hmm, I wonder."
dialogues.text: "Hmm, I wonder."

dialogues.jp:
しばらく三人でもくもくとメシを食っていると、
杉並が言った。
dialogues.en:
The three of us, chewing on our food, were interrupted by
Suginami's words.
dialogues.text:
The three of us, chewing on our food, were interrupted by
Suginami's words.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「こういうのもピクニックのようでなかなか楽
　しいじゃないか、なあ？」
dialogues.en: "This kind of picnic-style lunch is pretty fun, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "This kind of picnic-style lunch is pretty fun, isn't it?"

dialogues.jp: 野郎三人で体育館裏のこの状況がか？
dialogues.en:
Three rascals hiding behind the gym produces this kind of
situation now?
dialogues.text:
Three rascals hiding behind the gym produces this kind of
situation now?

dialogues.jp:
相変わらずと言えば、相変わらずだが、どーゆー
感受性をしとるんだ、この男……。
dialogues.en: This guy will never change his sensitivity...
dialogues.text: This guy will never change his sensitivity...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「さもなければ、代官山あたりのオープンカフェ
　か。うむ、優雅な気分だ」
dialogues.en:
"It feels like an open-air cafe in Daikan'yama, an elegant
nature to it."
dialogues.text:
"It feels like an open-air cafe in Daikan'yama, an elegant
nature to it."

dialogues.jp: フォロー屋工藤もさすがに無言になる。
dialogues.en: Kudou somehow managed to keep himself from saying anything.
dialogues.text: Kudou somehow managed to keep himself from saying anything.

dialogues.jp:
いくらなんでもここをオープンカフェ風とは言
い難いからな。
dialogues.en: It is rather hard to imagine this as an "open-air cafe"...
dialogues.text: It is rather hard to imagine this as an "open-air cafe"...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「どうだ、これから毎日俺ら三人で昼飯を食わ
　んか」
dialogues.en:
"How about the three of us come here to eat every day from
now on."
dialogues.text:
"How about the three of us come here to eat every day from
now on."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お断りだ」
dialogues.en: "I refuse."
dialogues.text: "I refuse."

dialogues.jp:
「食わんか」の「か」さえ言い終わらぬ前に、
俺は速攻で断った。
dialogues.en:
Before he could even finish the "on", I voiced my
disapproval.
dialogues.text:
Before he could even finish the "on", I voiced my
disapproval.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「右に同じ」
dialogues.en: "Same here."
dialogues.text: "Same here."

dialogues.jp: 工藤もそれに続く。
dialogues.en: Kudou quickly followed up.
dialogues.text: Kudou quickly followed up.

dialogues.speaker: Sugianmi
dialogues.jp:
「む……残念だな。折角気ままな独身貴族が三
　人揃っているというのに」
dialogues.en:
"Hm... regrettable. I thought we were three bachelors of
equal status."
dialogues.text:
"Hm... regrettable. I thought we were three bachelors of
equal status."

dialogues.jp: さわやかな笑みで同意を求める杉並。
dialogues.en: Suginami accepted our responses with a knowing smile.
dialogues.text: Suginami accepted our responses with a knowing smile.

dialogues.jp: （俺を数に入れるなあぁぁぁ！！）
dialogues.en: "(This is why I didn't want to be around people!!)"
dialogues.text: "(This is why I didn't want to be around people!!)"

dialogues.jp:
あぁ、静かな状況でメシを食いたいというささ
やかな望みさえも叶わないのだろうか。
dialogues.en:
I wished and wished for him to just shut up and eat quietly,
but it never came true.
dialogues.text:
I wished and wished for him to just shut up and eat quietly,
but it never came true.

dialogues.jp: ……切ない話だ。
dialogues.en: ...He never stopped talking.
dialogues.text: ...He never stopped talking.

dialogues.jp:
｛そしゃく／咀嚼｝したパンを飲み込んで、俺はふかぶかと溜
息をついたのだった。
dialogues.en: Biting my bread, I sighed deeply.
dialogues.text: Biting my bread, I sighed deeply.

dialogues.jp: ◆トリオで昼食１◆
dialogues.en: ◆The Lunch Trio 1◆
dialogues.text: ◆The Lunch Trio 1◆

dialogues.jp:
昼休み、静けさを求めて行った体育館裏には、
工藤と杉並がいた。
dialogues.en:
During lunch break, I thought I'd eat somewhere quiet so I
went to the back of the gym, but Suginami and Kudou were
there.
dialogues.text:
During lunch break, I thought I'd eat somewhere quiet so I
went to the back of the gym, but Suginami and Kudou were
there.

dialogues.jp:
結局、男三人でいつもどおり馬鹿話をしながら
昼飯を食ったのだった…。
dialogues.en:
Eventually, we talked about random little nothings as lunch
break slowly passed...
dialogues.text:
Eventually, we talked about random little nothings as lunch
break slowly passed...
